about: Provenance manifest for every image/stitch file under digitizer/testdata, app/e2e/fixtures, app/src/lib/fixtures, app/public, test/fixtures and docs/renders. Checked by test/asset-provenance.test.js. `status` is a recorded claim, not a licence grant. review:true marks entries Kent has not settled. Add a row when you add a file. docs/renders is forgiving: new render directories fall under a catch-all and a per-directory entry may be deleted with its directory; every other root is strict.
